literal_semantic_review.literal_label: Tissu dense, compact et à forte valeur historique de la vieille ville & faubourgs
literal_semantic_review.meaning: Thematic representation of dense compact historic urban tissue, with A1 constraints preserving character during transformation and renovation; not a legal protection inventory or new building entitlement.

source_evidence.62: Vieille-Ville contains a majority of protected heritage buildings and is expected to evolve little; that statement does not identify each building as legally protected.
source_evidence.63: A1 frames conditions of transformation to avoid denaturing existing buildings while permitting renovation.
source_evidence.64: Changes to listed/inventoried/rated objects preserve substance; tree/garden safeguards and sector plans remain distinct implementation work.

semantic_mapping.method: manual thematic correspondence using complete source overlay, building-shaped legend symbol, exclusive Vieille-Ville/faubourgs spatial distribution and operative A1 text

limits: No protected/listed status assigned to individual buildings from broad tissue category.
No capacity, vacancy, right to demolish/build or legal heritage boundary claim.
No compound topology repair or inferred envelope.
Raw whole hull/commune validation, exact native PDF rendering clips only; no domain clipping.

transformed_union_topology_holds.reason: Individually valid original native supports form a near-zero union ring that collapses on EPSG4326 transformation. Entire interacting cluster withheld; no repair, rounding or fabricated closure.
transformed_union_topology_holds.failed_owned_rehearsal: Safely rolled back before live delivery; historical failure remains evidence.

approval_review.title: Vevey — Plan directeur communal V6 du 22 août 2024, approuvé 2 octobre 2024

signed_approval.scope: Signed whole municipal PDCom. Territorial project objectives, principles and measures guide municipal implementation; not every historical diagnosis or population/capacity estimate is a current binding private right.
signed_approval.version_note: Signature sheet footer differs from main version; this distinction is preserved. Exact officially published signed PDF hash is verified; no rewritten or substituted source.

approval_review.diagnostic_vintage_limit: PDF11 explains capacity evaluation made2020/2021 from draft zoning revisions and existing built surfaces; horizon2040 projections and diagnostic data must retain their source dates, not treated as current parcel rights or remaining unbuilt capacity.
limits: Approved municipal main source distinct from regional Rivelac plans or former1997 PDCom.
Original signature PDF149 is image-only for native-text extraction; visual approval evidence is separate, not an OCR transcript.
Cover22Aug2024 and approval-sheet footer2Apr2024 remain distinguishable; approval date2Oct2024 is visually stamped and independently corroborated.
Source project objectives/principles/measures PDF43 do not turn diagnostic estimates, proposed zoning or development horizons into current construction rights.
No geometry qualification, parcel intersections, full-text completeness or commune completion is asserted; all empty/native-text gaps remain auditable.

currentness_evidence.finding: Municipal synthesis confirms council1February2024/canton2October2024 and entry into force.
